name: Dossier file
oneLiner: a kraft file folder slides onto a leather desk, a person's photo print drops on and a steel paper clip goes over its edge, the name, role and three facts type on like a typewriter, then a brand-colour rubber stamp thumps across it
say: when the speaker introduces someone or something with a few facts ('meet the person who...', 'here is the file on'): the facts type on as they list them and the stamp lands on the verdict
